say:2:1041566301:1.text: My shoulder and neck muscles have been feeling a bit tight lately.
say:2:1041566301:1.source_cn: 最近肩膀和脖颈的肌肉总是紧绷绷的。

say:3:1041566302:1.text: I've consulted a physician and asked guards to help, but nothing has worked.
say:3:1041566302:1.source_cn: 虽然让亲卫帮忙按过，也请过医师，但效果有限啊。

say:4:1041566303:1.text: I hear you. Long hours of wielding my spear isn't the same as when I was younger. Parts of my body feel like an old worn shoe.
say:4:1041566303:1.source_cn: 毕竟岁数到了，又要经常挥舞武器，常运动的地方就常有损耗。

say:5:1041566304:1.text: Ah, it's nice to talk to a seasoned warrior. Everyone is too young around here.
say:5:1041566304:1.source_cn: 噢，看起来你也是一位身经百战的战士。

say:6:1041566305:1.text: Your injuries must've been life-changing. Did it happen long ago? Though you seem like you can hold your spear well enough.
say:6:1041566305:1.source_cn: 你这手臂上的伤真了不得，多少年了？看着恢复得也不错。

say:7:1041566306:1.text: I don't exactly remember exactly. It must've been at least ten or twenty years ago. Whenever it rains, my joints and bones feel the dampness.
say:7:1041566306:1.source_cn: 记不清了，总有十几二十年了，现在每逢刮风下雨骨头缝那其...

say:8:1041566307:1.text: Well, that's inevitable. I don't have any scars or wounds as serious as yours, but the dampness affects me too. I get itchy all over.
say:8:1041566307:1.source_cn: 难免的，我身上没你这么重的伤，到潮湿的地方也发痒。

say:9:1041566308:1.text: It's because of these prosthetic arms that I can hold my spear. They were created by a young Wilder inventor. Good kid...
say:9:1041566308:1.source_cn: 至于这假肢，是某位发明家帮我弄的，附带了魔法，能减轻发力。

say:10:1041566309:1.text: But after using them for so long, some places do hurt. On days like this, I need to stretch myself to relieve the pain.
say:10:1041566309:1.source_cn: 只不过用久了，该疼的地方也还是疼，只能自己多拉伸。

say:11:1041566310:1.text: Indeed, healing magic can help relieve pain a little but is often of no use.
say:11:1041566310:1.source_cn: 是啊，治疗魔法最多也就止痛，经常派不上用场。

say:12:1041566311:1.text: You can only stretch and try to relax your muscles. To be honest, I don't think healing magic even helps.
say:12:1041566311:1.source_cn: 只能经常拉伸放松，说实话，治疗魔法也不一定管用。

say:13:1041566312:1.text: Yes, I agree. Those mages and priests always think that magic solves everything, but sometimes it's just useless.
say:13:1041566312:1.source_cn: 没错，我赞成，那些魔法师祭司总觉得魔法是万能的，但有时...

say:14:1041566313:1.text: In the end, you still have to rely on your own training and experience to know what to do.
say:14:1041566313:1.source_cn: 还是得靠自己锻炼和调整，心里才会有数。

say:15:1041566314:1.text: If you want to survive the battlefield, you have to understand and master your body first
say:15:1041566314:1.source_cn: 要上战场的人，只有自己掌握自己的身体，才能保住自身的生命。
